value.rationale: Natural complete fixed-target squaring-fiber problem in every finite full transformation monoid. The exact matching weights depend on kernel sizes and account for previously uncounted interactions between exchanged fibers; the accompanying formal generating function gives the entire rank distribution for squares that are idempotent. Neither arbitrary kernel profiles nor the two-variable rank series are merely finite-table recomputations. The established constant- and identity-target cases are explicitly credited.
